strings.compare.field-gradient-unknown: How the wavelength changes across the picture is unknown.
strings.compare.field-matched: The wavelengths match across the whole picture.
strings.compare.field-no-matched-pair: No exposure pair with matching wavelengths, so no difference image.
strings.compare.field-shifted: Wavelengths match at the star but not across the whole picture, so no difference image.
strings.compare.matched-pairs: Compared only through exposures with matching wavelengths.
strings.compare.no-exposures: One of the dates has no usable exposure.
strings.compare.no-spectral-overlap: The two pictures saw different wavelengths.
strings.compare.position-different-response: Positions can be compared, but the wavelengths differ.
strings.compare.response-matched: Same detector and the same wavelength at the star.
strings.compare.response-shifted: Same detector, but the wavelengths differ too much for a brightness comparison.
strings.compare.response-unknown: The wavelength of one picture is unknown.
strings.credit.base-project: Built on the team's earlier SPHEREx Blink project.
strings.credit.comet-table: 3I/ATLAS exposure list: SPHEREx team, via IRSA.
strings.credit.gaia: Positions and motions of comparison stars: ESA Gaia DR3.
strings.credit.spherex: SPHEREx is a NASA mission led by Caltech and managed by JPL.
strings.explain.brightness-insufficient: No pair of dates has the same wavelength and clean pixels at the star, so no brightness change is reported.
strings.explain.brightness-measured: In matching wavelengths the star was {value} times as bright on date B as on date A (± {sigma}).
strings.explain.control: Check: {n_stars} ordinary field stars were measured the same way and compared with Gaia. Share that agree within the 95% region: {fraction}.
strings.explain.fixed-sky-pair: Two dates of the same patch of sky: the body moves across the background stars.
strings.explain.motion-insufficient: The SPHEREx exposures here do not give enough clean positions to measure the motion.
strings.explain.motion-measured: SPHEREx positions from {n_points} exposures over {days} days give a proper motion of {value} ± {sigma} arcsec per year. Gaia DR3 lists {catalogue} arcsec per year.
strings.explain.moving-object-cutouts: Each picture is centred on where the ephemeris puts the body at that moment, so the stars move and the body stays near the centre.
strings.explain.not-available: SPHEREx data for this target are not available here yet: {reason}.
strings.explain.see-only: This target is shown for looking only. It is not part of the prediction tests.
strings.explain.training-only: Only the training visits are opened. The newest visit stays closed until the prediction is frozen.
strings.limit.aperture-whole-pixels: Brightness is summed over whole pixels inside a circle.
strings.limit.blended-binary: This is a close pair of stars; at SPHEREx resolution both are measured together.
strings.limit.catalogue-assisted-identification: The star was found using its catalogue position and motion.
strings.limit.control-not-passed: The field-star check did not pass, so the uncertainty may be underestimated.
strings.limit.detection-not-validated: No detection of this body has been validated in these pictures.
strings.limit.ephemeris-guided: Cutouts follow the JPL Horizons ephemeris (catalogue-assisted).
strings.limit.few-visits-parallax: Only a few visits: the parallax fit is sensitive to small errors that differ from visit to visit.
strings.limit.gaussian-psf-model: Positions come from a simple bell-shaped star model, not the full SPHEREx PSF.
strings.limit.joint-fit-epochs: The body is too faint for single pictures; each date's position comes from one fit to all its pictures together.
strings.limit.no-parallax-baseline: Straight-line fit that ignores parallax: a simple comparison, not the best model.
strings.limit.official-table-positions: Pictures are centred on the comet positions given in the official SPHEREx exposure table.
strings.limit.parallax-from-catalogue: The yearly parallax wobble uses the Gaia distance (catalogue-assisted).
strings.limit.parallax-not-modelled: The yearly parallax wobble is not modelled.
strings.limit.saturated-core-wing-fit: The star's centre is saturated; its position comes from the outer glow only.
strings.limit.see-only: For looking only: no measurement or prediction is made for this target.
strings.limit.visit-systematics: The free parallax fit disagrees with Gaia, a sign of visit-to-visit errors; uncertainties may be too small.
strings.limit.wcs-wave-approximate: Wavelengths come from the approximate lookup table in each file (about 1 nm).
strings.measure.annulus-too-small: Too few clean sky pixels around the star.
strings.measure.aperture-empty: No pixels inside the measuring circle.
strings.measure.baseline-too-short: The dates span too short a time for a motion fit.
strings.measure.fit-at-bound: The star model hit a limit; the position is not trusted.
strings.measure.fit-failed: The star model did not fit.
strings.measure.fit-singular: The star model could not be constrained.
strings.measure.flagged-pixels-in-aperture: Flagged pixels (for example saturation) cover the star.
strings.measure.low-snr: The star is too faint here for a reliable position.
strings.measure.no-measured-matched-pair: No matching-wavelength pair with clean pixels at the star.
strings.measure.null-test-failed: A check with shuffled times also found a signal (likely a star), so this is not counted.
strings.measure.outside-cutout: The star is outside this picture.
strings.measure.too-few-epochs: Too few positions for a motion fit.
strings.measure.too-few-good-pixels: Too few clean pixels around the star.
strings.product.unusable-quality-metadata: The file's quality flags could not be read safely.
strings.quality.l2-dqa-not-pass: The SPHEREx quality check did not pass for this exposure.
strings.quality.target-outside-cutout: The target is outside this exposure's picture.
strings.quantity.control_fraction_within_95pct: Field-star check: share of comparison stars whose measured motion agrees with Gaia
strings.quantity.flux_ratio_b_over_a: Brightness ratio, date B over date A, same wavelength
strings.quantity.parallax_arcsec: Parallax from SPHEREx positions alone (arcsec, exploratory)
strings.quantity.proper_motion_east_arcsec_yr: Proper motion towards east (arcsec per year)
strings.quantity.proper_motion_north_arcsec_yr: Proper motion towards north (arcsec per year)
strings.quantity.proper_motion_total_linear_arcs: Total proper motion, straight-line fit without parallax (arcsec per year)
strings.reserved.rule: Live loading is paused near these paths so reserved observations stay unopened.
strings.reserved.see-only: See-only target: live loading is paused along its path.
strings.reserved.until-predictions-frozen: Until the predictions are frozen and published.
strings.unavailable.holdout-closed: the newest visit is reserved for the prediction test
strings.unavailable.no-current-product: the exposure listed in the official table has no current (DR1) product
